mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_session_share (id, tenant_id, session_id, owner_user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, NULL, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, session_id, owner_user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at FROM ds_session_share WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant_id, session_id, owner_user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at FROM ds_session_share WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} LIMIT 1
